biggest_catch: You must complete BOTH a $750/month direct deposit AND 10 debit card transactions per month within the first 60 days — missing either one in a month disqualifies you, and the doctorofcredit page for the general Five Star offer is marked expired.
catches: Requires at least $750 in qualifying direct deposits PER MONTH within the first 60 days AND at least 10 debit card transactions per month in the same 60-day period — a dual monthly requirement.
Qualifying direct deposits are recurring payroll/pension/government ACH only; Zelle, Venmo, account-to-account transfers, and branch/ATM deposits do not qualify.
The $200 bonus is deposited within 30 days after all requirements are met — not immediately at account opening.
Account must be open and in good standing at the time of payout; one bonus per member.
A $25 minimum opening deposit and a $5 share savings account are required for membership.
Membership eligibility is required (Five Star serves AL/GA — confirm you qualify before applying).
No fixed end date is given — the official page says the offer is subject to change or termination without notice.

steps: Open a new Five Star checking account online with a $25 minimum opening deposit, and establish membership with a $5 share savings account.
Within the first 60 days of account opening, receive at least $750 in qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, or government ACH — not Zelle/Venmo/account transfers) per month.
Within the same 60 days, complete at least 10 debit card transactions that post per month.
Enroll in and access online or mobile banking, and enroll in eStatements.
The $200 bonus is deposited into the qualifying account within 30 days after all requirements are met; keep the account open and in good standing until then.
